detailed_description:
__Create Your Own Animation__ is a visual workflow feature by **GMI Cloud** that lets you bring your own character to life and turn ideas into animated stories.


Using **Seedream** for character creation and **Kling** for animation, this workflow allows you to design a unique character and animate it across scenes to build your own narrative.
Perfect for creators who want to experiment with animation storytelling—no complex setup required. Just customize your character, define the scene, and watch your story unfold.

Running this workflow could take up to a few minutes. Please be patient.

parameters.name: animation_style
parameters.description: Your Animate Style prompt(e.g., Disney / Pixar / anime style, etc.).
parameters.default_value: create a Disney animated style portrait, like characters in Frozen

parameters.name: animation_prompt
parameters.description: Video motion/story prompt for this video.
parameters.default_value:
A girl slowly walks up a staircase in a quiet indoor setting.
The camera starts in front of her, capturing a medium shot as she takes a few steps upward.
The camera then smoothly transitions behind her, following her back as she continues climbing the stairs.
The camera shifts again into a close-up of her face from the front.
Her eyes begin to tear up, and she quietly starts crying.
Soft, natural lighting, realistic motion, cinematic camera movement, emotional atmosphere.
